hypothesis: EWY regular-session body direction adds predictive and net economic value for the NEXT eligible Korean session AFTER its open, beyond domestic prior-session information
consumed_data: Previously observed 6 Korean survivor stocks and the 2025-10-17..2026-10-16 cache are exploratory only
input: EWY_BODY_RETURN=CLOSE/OPEN-1, raw regular-session OHLCV only; no NAV/FX/SOXX fabricated inputs
mapping: Use timezone-aware America/New_York, Asia/Seoul and UTC with verified US calendar holidays/early closes and observed Korean index session dates. Map each completed actual US price session to the first eligible Korean decision after it becomes available; if multiple US sessions map to one KR day, use latest completed. Do not carry/repeat a previously consumed US signal over a US holiday
kr_special_sessions: Exclude inherited 2025-11-13 and 2026-01-02 from regular-open models; no fabricated 09:00 special-session prices
historical_availability: Separate actual acquisition/received time and evidenced historical publication time. Strict track requires actual publication<=decision. Price-only exploratory track may assume official US regular close +60 minutes, labeled HISTORICAL_PUBLICATION_UNVERIFIED. Never mutate actual timestamps or grant G1/OOS approval
evaluation: Common fresh-EWY mapped KR days with valid stock/index prior closes and OHLC; report all exclusions and full cash ledger dates. Gap OPEN/priorCLOSE-1 is diagnostic only, body CLOSE/OPEN-1 is open-model label. 09:05 performance NULL without actual intraday observations

rules.DOM_STOCK: 25% long if prior stock close / its preceding close -1 >0, otherwise cash
rules.DOM_INDEX: 25% long if corresponding prior index close / preceding close -1 >0, otherwise cash
rules.H1_EWY: 25% long if freshly mapped EWY body>0, otherwise cash
rules.EWY_AND_DOM_INDEX: 25% long only if both H1 and DOM_INDEX are positive
rules.EWY_AND_DOM_STOCK: 25% long only if both H1 and DOM_STOCK are positive
rules.EWY_DELAY_ONE_US_SESSION: Valid-causal placebo using preceding actual completed US session body, never a synthetic holiday session

execution: Reuse unchanged ReferencePortfolio costs/cash/lot accounting. Target .25 sized from prior close NAV, entry limit prior close*1.05, prior-volume*.001 integer capacity; assumed regular open+1s adverse-slippage anchor, 1-minute entry expiry. Sell target0 decision15:19, limit prior close*.70 known before close; assumed closing-price anchor15:30:01, expiry15:31. No current final volume for opening eligibility. No T/T+1 sale-proceeds reuse; no automatic favorable fill or terminal liquidation. Unresolved exits block new entries and remain RISK_REDUCTION_HOLD; any overnight inventory-gap PnL separately identified
statistics: BASE primary only. Aggregate six stock outcomes within each KR date before inference (not a pooled account). Circular moving-block bootstrap, 5 KR-date blocks, B1000 seed404, percentile95 CI and centered two-sided bootstrap p=(1+count(abs(boot-observed)>=abs(observed)))/(B+1). Holm correction alpha.05 over three endpoints. No independent 6*N observations or ordinary random train/test split
minimum_evidence: At least80 distinct common KR dates, at least20 EWY-positive and20 nonpositive dates; otherwise INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. No synthetic replacement for actual prices
falsification: Future US-session wrong-date mapping must fail the availability validator; any diagnostic association is non-tradable and never selectable
Prior20-index-return regimes bullish>=.05 bearish<=-.05 neutral otherwise
Leave-one-stock and leave-one-KR-month diagnostics plus top5-date concentration; cluster by KR date
Future append/correction must not change earlier signal IDs
exposure_diagnostic: POSTHOC_DIAGNOSTIC only: pair common=min(actual mean exposures), scale cash-excess PnL by common/own mean. Zero denominator=>NULL, equal full risk false, no allocation feedback
supported_criteria: Sufficient real data; positive body effect and at least one positive incremental endpoint all passing their Holm tests; H1 BASE cash excess positive>=4/6 and STRESS positive>=4/6; index-combination improves domestic-index BASE net>=4/6; top5 KR-date contribution share<=.5 of positive date-cluster excess. This is exploratory support only and not execution certification
not_supported_criteria: Sufficient data and computable endpoints but supported criteria fail; report gap-only effects, exposure, costs and concentration separately
data_blocked_criteria: No adequate real EWY regular-session OHLC or calendar provenance / access unavailable; continue unrelated code and tests; do not replace economics with fixtures
nav: Independent optional path. NAV reference/valuation time is not publication time. Missing publication evidence => NAV_PUBLICATION_UNVERIFIED only; do not block price-only track
new_authenticated_collection: Not authorized by this protocol. Exact EWY API/exchange/interval/pages/auth/retry budget must be separately approved before calls
